personality_one_liner: A pristine, official, and tactical command center that honors the club's maroon and royal blue colors while prioritizing high legibility and operational speed.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for roster lists; precise tight grids for the tactical pitch. Always account for bottom safe area on sticky CTAs.

do's: Use frosted glass on the bottom tab bar.
Use glass for sticky header overlays when roster lists scroll behind them.
Use glass on the bottom sheet that slides up over the pitch for player selection.
dont's: Do not use glass on player cards inside the roster list.
Do not use glass on form inputs.

screens.name: Splash
screens.purpose: Brand presentation at launch with the club's crest.
screens.layout: Full screen brandPrimary (#7A1E2E) background. Center the user-provided 'Città di Spoltore' logo. No other UI elements.

states.loading: Static logo view while local storage hydrates.

screens.name: Rosa (Roster)
screens.purpose: Manage the complete list of 11-a-side players (add, edit, photo, role, number).
screens.layout: List view categorized by role (Portieri, Difensori, Centrocampisti, Attaccanti). Each player is a card with photo (or initials avatar), number in bold, and name. Use a floating action button (FAB) with glass effect to add a new player. Roster saved locally.

states.empty: Illustration of a jersey with 'Nessun giocatore in rosa. Aggiungi il primo!' and an 'Aggiungi Giocatore' button.
states.error: Message 'Errore nel caricamento della rosa' with a Retry button.

screens.name: Formazione (Pitch/Tactics)
screens.purpose: Select the tactical module and assign players to their positions on the pitch.
screens.layout: Vertical scroll-locked view. Top header: Module picker (e.g., 4-4-2, 4-3-3). Main area: Vertical green pitch background (using image). Player slots map to the selected module. Tap a slot to open a glassmorphic bottom sheet containing available players (Rosa). Tap a player to assign them. Includes a 'Save Scheme' button at the top right.

states.loading: Spinner over an empty pitch outline.
states.empty: Pitch shows empty position slots based on the default 4-4-2 module.
states.error: Message 'Errore nel caricamento del modulo' with a Retry button.

screens.name: Convocati (Call-ups)
screens.purpose: Select which players from the roster are called up for the upcoming match.
screens.layout: Top section: Inputs for 'Avversario' (Opponent) and 'Data' (Date). Main section: Checkbox list of all players grouped by role. Bottom: Sticky primary CTA 'Salva Convocati' that stays fixed while the list scrolls.

states.empty: Illustration of a clipboard with 'Aggiungi giocatori alla rosa per poterli convocare'.
states.error: Message 'Errore nel caricamento dei giocatori' with a Retry button.

screens.name: Moduli/Stampa (Print)
screens.purpose: Generate and share PDF versions of the roster, call-ups, and formations.
screens.layout: Grid of three large cards: 'Distinta Convocati', 'Formazione in Campo', 'Rosa Completa'. Tapping a card triggers PDF generation using expo-print and opens the native share sheet to print or send via WhatsApp/email.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design constraint: Follow iOS-Native Clean (Personality 1). App must feel official, clean, and highly structured.

Brand colors applied: The user specifically requested 'Città di Spoltore' crest colors. Maroon/Burgundy (#7A1E2E) is the primary brand color, and Royal Blue (#1F5FAE) acts as secondary. Base backgrounds use a warm off-white (Beige tower reference).
Zero Tolerance: Do not use generic emoji for any system UI elements. Use Ionicons consistently.

Splash Screen: The user mentioned 'ti allego il logo' (I attached the logo). Since you don't have direct access to their local attachment, build an Image component pointing to a local asset path (e.g., require('../assets/images/logo.png')) and add a placeholder or fallback. Instruct the user to drop their logo into the assets folder.

Tactical Pitch Logic: The pitch must orient vertically. Map out module coordinates (4-4-2, 4-3-3, 3-5-2) so that empty slots dynamically render over the pitch background image based on the picker selection.

Local Storage: All data (players, images, saved formations, match details) must be stored using AsyncStorage or a local SQLite database (e.g., expo-sqlite) since the user explicitly requested local-only storage.
PDF Generation: Use expo-print to generate HTML-to-PDF layouts for the Distinta, Formazione, and Rosa, and use expo-sharing to allow the user to print or share the resulting PDF.
